verdict.line: You lose if you let Mundo free-farm to his Q max-health poke and Masochism duels; you win if you land W (Bellows Breath) on cooldown and force all-ins before he hits his power spike.

brief.thesis: Ornn vs Dr. Mundo sits at 46.8% over 186 games despite Ornn holding the lane and solo-kill edge, because Mundo's Passive (Adrenaline Rush) and Q (Infected Cleaver) punish passive farming lanes with sustained health-percent damage that Ornn can't out-sustain through trades alone. OP.GG's own read confirms it: W (Bellows Breath) deals heavy damage to tanky targets like Mundo, so this is a lane won by cooldown discipline, not by winning any single exchange.

theirWindow.what: Masochism scales his bonus Attack Damage off missing health, so a low-HP Mundo hits far harder than his bar suggests. Don't trade into him when he looks weak — that's exactly when his auto-attacks spike.

yourWindow.what: Walk in and land the full breath channel for the Brittle application and bonus damage to tanky Mundo — this is your single highest-value action in the lane per OP.GG's own tip, so never let it sit on cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s).

start.why: Runs 45.1% winrate over 65.7% pick share here — the sustain blunts Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver) poke and Adrenaline Rush regen war before you have Grasp stacks rolling.

boots.why: 49.5% winrate at 54.5% pick — Mundo's damage leans on autos and cleaver spam, so the flat reduction outvalues Mercury's Treads' tenacity here.

core.why: Most-run opener in the top core path (75% over sampled games), and its burn stacks with your W for extra pressure on a high-HP target like Mundo.
Appears in both top-performing core paths — the omnivamp and shield sustain directly answer Mundo's self-sustain race.

runes.keystoneWhy: Runs in both top rune pages (46.8% and 47.2% winrate) — the proc punishes Mundo for standing in melee range on cooldown, which he has to do to land Burning Agony and autos.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the dominant pairing at 78.5% pick and a 44.7% winrate — Teleport lets you reset after Mundo's sustain-heavy trades without surrendering top-side tempo.

playing.title: Fire W on every cooldown
playing.detail: OP.GG flags this directly: Bellows Breath deals heavy damage to tanky champions like Mundo. Walk it onto him every single time it's up (12s base, down to 10s at max rank) — this is the single biggest lever you have in the matchup.

playing.title: Don't trade into low-HP Mundo
playing.detail: His E (Masochism) grants bonus AD scaling off missing health, so a Mundo under 50% HP hits harder in melee than his health bar implies. Disengage instead of finishing a 'won' trade.

playing.title: Punish before Sadism is up
playing.detail: His R (Sadism) on a 75s cooldown sacrifices health for movement speed and heavy regen — your all-in windows are strongest in the seconds right after he's used it, since he's temporarily lower on HP and on a long cooldown.

playing.title: Use E (Searing Charge) off minions for the knockup
playing.detail: Charging into terrain near him creates a shockwave that knocks up and damages enemies in the blast — set this up off walls near the lane to open trades Mundo can't walk out of.

playing.title: R (Call of the Forge God) to force the all-in
playing.detail: At levels 6-8 your summoned elemental slows and applies Brittle on contact, and you can recast to redirect and knock up — use it to start fights on your terms before Mundo's late sustain curve kicks in.

playing.title: Hold Q (Volcanic Rupture) for the slow, not just damage
playing.detail: The fissure's slow lets you stick W's Brittle application on him — sequence Q into W rather than firing both on cooldown without a plan.

playing.title: Prioritize wave state over greedy trades
playing.detail: Since the matchup is close to even (46.8%), don't force unnecessary exchanges — farm behind Grasp procs and let Hollow Radiance/Jak'Sho scaling take over from level 14 onward.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning connecting them to specific cooldowns and trade windows is this brief's own analysis.
